import sys
import heapq

def dijkstra(graph, start, n):
    dist = [float('inf')] * (n + 1)
    dist[start] = 0
    pq = [(0, start)]
    while pq:
        d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if d > dist[u]:
            continue
        for v in graph[u]:
            if dist[v] > dist[u] + 1:
                dist[v] = dist[u] + 1
                heapq.heappush(pq, (dist[v], v))
    return dist

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    index = 0
    n = int(data[index])
    m = int(data[index + 1])
    index += 2
    
    graph = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for _ in range(m):
        u = int(data[index])
        v = int(data[index + 1])
        graph[u].append(v)
        index += 2
    
    k = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    p = [int(data[index + i]) for i in range(k)]
    index += k
    
    dist_from_s = dijkstra(graph, p[0], n)
    dist_to_t = dijkstra(graph, p[-1], n)
    
    min_rebuilds = 0
    max_rebuilds = 0
    
    for i in range(k - 1):
        if dist_from_s[p[i]] + dist_to_t[p[i + 1]] < dist_from_s[p[i + 1]] + dist_to_t[p[i]]:
            min_rebuilds += 1
        if dist_from_s[p[i]] + dist_to_t[p[i + 1]] > dist_from_s[p[i + 1]] + dist_to_t[p[i]]:
            max_rebuilds += 1
    
    print(min_rebuilds, max_rebuilds)

if __name__ == "__main__":
